jordan_acme: Hey team — after the model swap this morning our JSON outputs are breaking our parser. Example top-level response: `{"items": [null, {\"id\": 1, \"value\": \"ok\"}], \"meta\": null}`. Our parser expects arrays of objects, not random nulls. Request ID: req_0a9f2b. Model: gpt-quantized-3b:v2.2. Deployed ~08:15 UTC. Can you advise?
maya_support: Thanks Jordan. Can you paste the raw streaming chunks (if available) or the exact response body? Also which SDK/language and parser are you using?
jordan_acme: We're on python requests hitting /v1/generate with content-type json. Our downstream uses json.loads and then iterates items. Full body (trimmed): `{"items": [null, {"id": 1, "value": "ok"}], "meta": null}` — so json.loads succeeds but then code fails on NoneType. We didn't see this on previous model.
sam_ml: tagging in. Initial hypothesis: quantized variant seems to add explicit nulls when the model outputs empty completions for some list positions (we've seen token-level "null" tokens surface in structured mode after a different tokenizer behavior). Did you have any format_instructions or schema enforcement?
jordan_acme: We use Redwood's JSON mode with format_instructions to emit an array of item objects. No extra wrappers. This worked fine before.
eli_runtime: Deploy-bot also posted a rollout for gpt-quantized-3b:v2.2 at 08:10 UTC — looks like a canary->global shift. Possible change in stop-token handling caused stray token sequences -> rendered as JSON nulls.
deploy-bot: rollout: gpt-quantized-3b:v2.2 promoted to stable in us-west-2 at 08:12 UTC (by ci/cd).
maya_support: Ok. Two-pronged ask: (1) Jordan, can you provide the full request payload (minus secrets) and the call config (max_tokens, stop sequences, stream: true/false, json_mode flag)? (2) Sam/eli, can runtime/ML check whether quantized model emits explicit JSON "null" tokens in structured output mode?
jordan_acme: Payload: `{"model":"gpt-quantized-3b:v2.2","input":"Generate items JSON","json_mode":true,"max_tokens":256,"stream":false}`. No custom stop sequences.
sam_ml: Quick repro attempt locally shows that when the model returns an empty object position it sometimes emits the literal token sequence `null` (as a tokenized atomic piece) which deserializes as JSON null. On non-quantized model the same slot collapses to omission (no entry). So schema drift here is structural: array length preserved but with null placeholders.
eli_runtime: That's consistent with a kernel/quantization change where the runtime pads vector slots with a sentinel emission. Need to confirm if padding is post-processed. Escalating to eng-runtime.
ops-oncall: @eli_runtime please add request_id req_0a9f2b and customer headers: x-cust-ctx: acme-frontend-2 in the ticket. If root cause is runtime padding, we need a hotfix or config flag to strip null entries in structured mode.
sam_ml: Mitigations for customers: (A) Update parser to filter nulls: `[o for o in data.get('items', []) if o is not None]` — quick, but opaque. (B) Pin to previous model tag (e.g., gpt-quantized-3b:v2.1) until we fix. (C) Add post-formatting in prompt: wrap output with `"items": [ ... ]` and include explicit `"omit_empty_slots": true` instructions — but that's fragile.
jordan_acme: Pinning is doable but we'd prefer a platform fix. Can you confirm rollback ETA?
eli_runtime: If confirmed, we can rollback the canary immediately in us-west-2 and run a patch to sanitize JSON for structured mode. I'll open a priority ticket.
maya_support: Jordan, sorry for the disruption. For immediate unblock could you try the parser filter from Sam? Also confirm whether you need historical data reprocessed.
jordan_acme: We'll try the filter, and yes we need to reprocess about 24h of items. If rollback ETA is <2 hours we'll wait, else will patch.
sam_ml: Long-term fix: Runtime should strip sentinel null tokens emitted at decode-time when json_mode=true and the model's top-level schema expects arrays of objects. Also add a regression test in the eval harness: compare array lengths before/after model swaps and fail on unexpected null insertions.
eli_runtime: Noted. Creating runtime ticket RT-4821 with logs and req_0a9f2b. Assigning to @eli_runtime and @sam_ml.
deploy-bot: incident note: automated canary check detected higher schema-drift rate for gpt-quantized-3b:v2.2 at 08:11 UTC.
ops-oncall: Flagging for oncall: this affects downstream parsers; potential customer impact.
maya_support: I'll follow up with Jordan once we have rollback or patch. Thanks everyone :pray: 
jordan_acme: Thanks — appreciate the quick help.
